\textbf{Justify your answers and show your work.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item Let ${\displaystyle \int_{2}^{4}f(x)\,dx=3}$ and ${\displaystyle \int_{4}^{6}f(x)\,dx=-2}$.
Find ${\displaystyle \int_{6}^{2}f(x)}\,dx$.\vspace{1.0in}
\item Find the indefinite integral of ${\displaystyle f(x)=\frac{x^{2}+1}{x^{2}}}$.\vspace{1.5in}
\item Evaluate ${\displaystyle \int_{0}^{\nicefrac{\pi}{2}}(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)\,d\theta}$.\vspace{1.5in}
\item (\textbf{HW }5.4: 23) What is the average distance between the parabola
$y=200x-10x^{2}$ and the $x$-axis on the interval $[0,20]$? (Your
answer can be a decimal approximated to one-hundredths.)\vspace{1.5in}
\item Use the substitution rule to evaluate $\int x(x^{2}+10)^{30}\,dx$.
\end{enumerate}
